Photo 1: Rear view of the same projector, showing ports including a blue VGA connector, audio jacks, power input, and 'EPSON' branding on the side.
Photo 2: Front view similar to photo 0, but with the lens cover closed. 'EPSON' branding visible on top and front.
All photos show a watermark 'DURABLE PROJECTORS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.
